title: Jubilant Vietnamese Vegetable Noodles
description: A briny, crunchy, and festive Vietnamese dish featuring vanilla bean paste and a mother-sauce-base, served in a lacquerware bowl, this plant-based friendly recipe is perfect for any occasion. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, combine the mother sauce, vanilla bean paste, salt, and pepper, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the carrots, red bell pepper, and snow peas to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned on all sides, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and sesame seeds, and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked noodles in a lacquerware bowl, and top with the vegetable and tofu mixture.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
Allow each guest to customize their own bowl with their choice of toppings, such as pickled ginger or sliced avocado.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
